title: CANAL ROOFTOPS // THE WATER DANCER'S NEEDLE
narrative: Arya vaulted across a three-foot alley gap between tiled Braavosi rooftops, the morning fog swirling off the Green Canal below. Behind her leaped a Faceless Man enforcer wearing the leathery visage of a guildsman. Needle sang from its scabbard. Quick as a snake, quiet as a shadow, Arya parried his poisoned stiletto, sidestepped his sweep, and drove Needle's three-sided steel point straight through his jugular. The assassin choked and tumbled headlong from the slate roof, splashing into the murky canal waters beneath a gondolier's oar. Arya wiped her slender blade on his sleeve, smiling like a direwolf.
